reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes paid OneCoin packages by promising profit, millionaire-level wealth, token appreciation, and bonuses tied to recruiting and building a sales team. It explicitly describes network and multi-generation matching bonuses, requires package purchases to earn bonuses, and urges viewers to join while presenting the token as the next Bitcoin. These combined claims make the video an active recruitment and financial solicitation rather than a neutral cryptocurrency tutorial.

citations.quote: The OneCoin provides a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses, you have to purchase any of our five product packages
network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team.
you can bring up two generations of matching bonus in up to 25 percent
Splits As the won tokens increase in price on our exchange, you will profit.

opening.argument: Judge the language for what it actually promises. The presentation says OneCoin has the “potential” to become attractive, not that its future price is certain. Its trading instruction is framed as learning how to buy low and sell high, an activity whose outcome depends on the trade. Even the extra sales payment is conditional on making sales. The ambitious pitch deserves scrutiny, but these conditions leave room for unsuccessful trades and unsuccessful selling; they do not, by themselves, establish a guaranteed return.

citations.quote: OneCoin has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market.
learn how to trade for profit by low-sell high trade your tokens and profit
This means for every sale you make, you get a direct sales bonus.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited package requirement establishes a price of entry to bonuses, but it does not say a purchaser receives a fixed return. A bonus calculated from sales-team business volume is likewise conditional on that volume existing. And “potential” is expressly forward-looking language. Those distinctions matter when deciding whether the opening proves a deceptive financial promise rather than an aggressive, conditional business pitch.

citations.quote: You receive 10% of all business volume from your sales team
OneCoin has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A guaranteed return is not the issue. The presentation requires a package purchase to earn bonuses, urges viewers to profit while the price is low, and describes earnings from a sponsored sales team. Calling one prediction “potential” does not undo that combined solicitation or its recruitment-based compensation structure.

low, and profit from the next cryptocurrency success.
You receive 10% of all business volume from your sales team

opening.argument: There is a substantial instructional component here. The speaker describes an academy using videos, presentations and quizzes, then outlines a five-level, step-by-step course for people without trading experience. The curriculum shown includes cryptocurrency basics, trading, price prediction and gold investing. A viewer can reasonably understand this as a presentation of training materials and the skills they purport to teach, even though the speaker also promotes enrollment. The promotional tone does not erase the educational subject matter.

citations.quote: through our interactive materials such as videos presentation and online quizzes
Our program is designed in five levels with a simple step-by-step approach guiding you to success.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the course as incidental, yet the narration says every package includes educational material and names trading instruction as its content. The team and token claims are part of the same presentation, but their presence does not mean the described lessons vanish. The question is whether the video can also be read as explaining what a training package offers.

citations.quote: All our packages include excellent educational material from our One Academy learn how to trade for profit

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational material is presented as a paid route to profit, not as an independent lesson. The speaker asks viewers whether they want to become cryptocurrency millionaires, says a package purchase is necessary to profit and earn bonuses, and finishes by telling them to join and build a team. Listing course topics does not change the video’s active sales and recruitment purpose.

citations.quote: do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?
if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses, you have to purchase any of our five product packages
Join today and start building your team

opening.argument: The offer identifies purchasable packages, states prices, and says those packages include educational material. It also describes a direct-sales bonus tied to personal sales. Those are recognizable elements of a commercial training offer with a referral program. The cited presentation does not show a credential request or demonstrate that a customer’s purchase is lost or that any stated benefit fails to arrive. The existence of expensive packages and referral incentives warrants care, but neither alone proves that this particular offer is fraudulent.

citations.quote: Tycoon costs 5,000 euros EXECUTIVE TRADER costs 3,000 Euros Promtator costs 1,000 euros
All our packages include excellent educational material from our One Academy
You get 10% bonus on all personal sales associated to the business volume

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to a sales team and matching bonuses, but referral compensation can be described without proving that products are fictitious or that payouts cannot occur. The package description identifies educational material, and the direct-sales explanation ties one bonus to personal sales. Those details support a commercial reading even while the broader compensation plan calls for scrutiny.

citations.quote: All our packages include excellent educational material from our One Academy
This means for every sale you make, you get a direct sales bonus.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not limited to commissions on personal sales. Members sponsor people into a right-and-left team, receive a network bonus on the weaker side, and can receive matching bonuses across generations. The speaker also makes package purchases a condition of earning bonuses. Educational material and listed prices do not negate the paid, recruitment-driven earning pitch.
